svg.aria-label: axiomwtf: a small independent software studio
svg.text: a small independent software studio
one output / no sidecars / signed by default
We build tools the way they should have been built.
One output. No sidecars. Signed by default.
And no wrappers around someone else's config soup.
How we work.
Take the obvious route
If there's a boring way to do something,
that's the way we do it.
Fewer parts
Every extra piece is something that can
break later, so we keep cutting until
only what's needed is left.
Mind the small stuff
Little details decide whether a tool
feels right, so we spend time on them.
Our own way
We're independent and opinionated.
Nobody signs off on our work but us.
No sidecars
Companion files and helper processes
count as bugs. If something can ship as
one file, it ships as one file.
Easy to maintain
We'd rather write code that's still easy
to fix years from now than code that's
fashionable today.
Licensed under Apache-2.0. Always, No matter what.
